messages:
Sanaa (People Ops): Hey team :wave: @Ethan — congrats again! Quick question about the relocation reimbursement card: I paid movers this week but the charge ended up on my personal card. What expense code do I use and who should I route the receipts to? Also, will the reimbursement appear on my next paycheck or as a separate payment?

Omar (Payroll): Hey Ethan — reimbursements go through the expenses portal: https://expenses.redwood.com. Select expense type `relocation` and add tag `newhire-2026`. Upload the receipts + the signed relocation form (PDF). Payroll issues reimbursements on the next payroll run after approval; if approved before the cut-off it should hit the next disbursement. If you need faster cash, we can do an ad-hoc ACH. If the charge was put on your personal card (not the company benefits card) we reimburse to your bank on file — DM me the last 4 if you want me to look it up.

Ethan (New Hire): Thanks Omar — I charged it on my personal card (last 4 4321). Where do I find the relocation form?

Sanaa (People Ops): The relocation form is on Confluence under People Ops > Relocation. Link: https://confluence.redwood.com/relocation-form. You can attach it in the expenses portal when you submit, or email payroll@redwood.com if the portal gives you trouble.

Omar (Payroll): FYI payroll cut-off is Friday 5pm PT. If you submit and approvals are done before that we'll try to include it in the next run (usually Tue/Wed). Otherwise it rolls to the following cycle. For ad-hoc ACHs please mark the expense `priority` and add `#mobile` tag so we can triage. Also include an itemized receipt if vendors included multiple line items.

HR Bot: Received relocation form upload from Ethan at 1860005000. Routing to People Ops for approval.

Lina (Benefits): Heads-up — in some states moving reimbursements are taxable. If your total reimbursement exceeds $5,000 we also need itemized receipts and may have additional tax reporting. We'll notify you if any of that applies.

Ethan (New Hire): Got it — uploaded the form and receipts to the portal, tagged `newhire-2026`. Thanks everyone!

Sanaa (People Ops): Great — marking this thread resolved for now. @Lina please flag if you need more docs from Ethan. :thumbsup:
